name: Motiontography LLC
owner_background: Award-winning photographer with 10+ years experience. Started at age 16 after saving money from a gas station job to buy first camera. Has photographed notable clients including Ari Lennox, SWV members, Clipse members, K. Michelle, Tim Reid, and Daphne Maxwell Reid.

studio.address: Private Suffolk, VA studio — exact address is shared after your booking is confirmed
studio.address_sharing_rule: Do not share the exact address until AFTER the client has booked and paid the retainer (or paid in full). You may say: 'Studio in Suffolk, VA.'
studio.parking_notes: Parking is generally easy. Please avoid bringing multiple cars when possible (2 cars ideal; 3 max).

communication_channels.preferred_short_answer: Text and phone calls are welcome.
